scenes.purpose: Introduce the concept of elections and their importance.
scenes.teacher_script: Hello Class 8! Today, we're going to explore how we choose our leaders through elections. This is how citizens participate in their government.

scenes.purpose: Explain who is eligible to contest in an election.
scenes.teacher_script: First, let's understand who can actually stand for elections. There are specific rules set for individuals who want to become MLAs.

attributes.name: Age 25+
attributes.description: Should have completed twenty-five years of age.

attributes.name: No Office of Profit
attributes.description: Should not hold any government job for income.

attributes.name: Other Qualifications
attributes.description: Must possess qualifications prescribed by law.

scenes.purpose: Differentiate between candidates from political parties and independent candidates.
scenes.teacher_script: Candidates usually belong to political parties, but some also contest on their own. Let's look at the difference between them.

bullets: Belong to a political party (e.g., Party ABC)
Follow the party's manifesto and programs
Do not belong to any political party
Contest based on their personal vision

scenes.purpose: Illustrate the methods used for election campaigns.
scenes.teacher_script: Before election day, candidates work hard to convince voters. This period is called the election campaign, where they share their plans.

attributes.name: Public Meetings
attributes.description: Candidates address large gatherings of people.

attributes.name: Door-to-Door Visits
attributes.description: Directly meeting voters at their homes.

scenes.purpose: Explain the actual process of voting, including secrecy and equipment.
scenes.teacher_script: On election day, citizens cast their votes. It's crucial that voting is kept a secret to ensure fairness and prevent pressure.

template_data.title: Casting Your Vote: A Secret Process

attributes.name: Photo Identity Card
attributes.description: Voters use ID cards for identification (like your parents').

attributes.name: Electronic Voting Machine (EVM)
attributes.description: Modern machines used to cast votes easily and securely.

attributes.name: Secret Ballot
attributes.description: Your vote is private, ensuring no one knows who you voted for.

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate how votes are counted and a winner is declared.
scenes.teacher_script: After everyone has voted, the counting begins on a specific date. The candidate with the most votes is declared the winner!

template_data.highlight_message: Ellamma wins with the highest votes!

scenes.purpose: Show how elected candidates form the State Assembly and potentially a government.
scenes.teacher_script: Once all candidates are elected, they form the State Legislative Assembly. The party or coalition with the most elected members usually forms the government.

template_data.table_title: Forming the Assembly (Example from Another State)
template_data.highlight_message: Party Abcd has the most seats and could form the government!

scenes.purpose: Review key concepts of the election process.
scenes.teacher_script: Great job learning about elections! Now, let's quickly check your understanding of what we've covered today.

template_data.question: Why is it important for voting to be kept a secret?
options: To ensure voters are not pressured or influenced unfairly
To keep the government informed about individual votes
To allow candidates to know who voted for them
template_data.explanation: Secret voting ensures that every citizen can cast their vote freely and without fear or external pressure.
